newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Burlington buys Dutch distributor Cleton & Company.
newsitem.headline: Burlington buys Dutch distributor Cleton & Company.

text.p: Burlington Air Express (BAX) has acquired Cleton & Company, a Dutch logistics and distribution company for an undisclosed sum.

In a statement, BAX said: "This gives BAX a significant advantage in one of Europe's key strategic markets. The Netherlands has historically been the centre of European transportation and distribution and any serious player in the global logistics arena must have strong operations established there."
Lex Cleton, owner of Cleton & Company, which has a turnover of 55 million guilders ($27.5 million), will continue to be the managing director of the Netherlands operations under the new structure.
Cleton & Company employs 170 people and operates more than 500,000 sq ft of logistics and distribution facilities, where it offers services including testing and assembly of products.
Cleton has clients include in the automotive, aerospace and hi-tech industries.
Steve Dearnley, BAX president, said in the statement that BAX also provides logistic services to the automotive industry that mirror those of Cleton in Tilburg.
He added: "This acquisition allows us to expand our European logistics capabilities with turn-key speed." - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+ 44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017 - www.racs.com
